learn_source: Conversation at the well in the Town scene — a neighbour mentions the old trick of pressing a sound into wax so it can be heard again
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a resonant surface once, with a sound you have actually heard and carry
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the replay is full and clear; at baseline it is thin and short, like the sound heard through a wall. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: The captured sound plays back out of the hollow, rounded by the stone
no_effect — soft material swallows the cast; nothing sounds
State-dependent: hanging free, the bell reproduces the sound with its own ring under it; muffled or held, only a dull knock escapes
No physical effect — the sound does not emit from a living body
receivers.reaction_kind: head-tilt toward the caster, one uncertain bark
stillness — she stops what she is doing until the failed cast's quiet passes
